member.summary: Compare two finger templates.

remarks.para: This method matches two templates and returns a score which describes the similarity of both templates. The template objects can be generated from fingerprint images using this component (please refer to the method) or from external sources using the method or a mixture of both. This is a symmetric function, i.e. the order of the two templates has no effect on the resulting score.

member.name: M:Dermalog.Afis.FingerCode3.Encoder.Encode(System.Drawing.Image)
member.summary: Encode a fingerprint image to a finger template.

remarks.para: This method is used to extract fingerprint templates out of fingerprint images. The fingerprint template returned by this method can be used to match two fingerprints using . They can also be stored for later use with the method.
All required properties should be set before calling

The encoding of fingerprint images is quite computational expensive. In order to be able to track the progress of the encoding (for use with e.g. progress bars etc.) the user can optionally set a callback () which is called periodically during the encoding and which reports the progress.
Please consider the Requirements for Fingerprint Images page.

member.summary: Instance of a template.

remarks.para: This object holds the finger template data. Use the and for template data IO. This enables to match with external templates as well as to store the template data for later use. The supported template formats depend on the license you purchased.
